name: csr-portal
description: CSR Portal for a car wash membership platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,red,cyan "npm run dev -w @csr-portal/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @csr-portal/api" "npm run dev -w @csr-portal/web"
scripts.deploy:portal: npm run build -w @csr-portal/shared && npm run build -w @csr-portal/web && npm run deploy -w @csr-portal/gateway

author: Andrew Jarnagin
